**`src/utils/jwt/jwt.ts`**
- `TokenHeader.typ` widened from `'JWT'` to `string` (`:40`).

- `verify` destructures `typ` and calls `isTokenHeader(header, typ)` (`:125`, `:138`).
- `verifyWithJwks` calls `isTokenHeader(header, verifyOpts.typ)` (`:230`); the option also flows through the existing `...verifyOpts` spread into `verify`.
- Middleware `verification?: VerifyOptions` already spreads into `Jwt.verify`, so `typ` passes through automatically (`src/middleware/jwt/jwt.ts:138-141`).

**`src/utils/jwt/jwt.test.ts`**
- Four `isTokenHeader` tests for default case/prefix normalization, default rejection of other types, explicit expected `typ`, and arrays of expected types (`:63-83`).
- `describe('typ')` covering `at+jwt` rejected by default / accepted when expected, and plain `JWT` rejected when `at+jwt` is expected (`:157-188`).

**`src/middleware/jwt/index.test.ts`**
- Added `describe('typ of the token')` verifying default 401 for an `at+jwt` token, 200 with `verification: { typ: 'at+jwt' }`, and 401 for a plain `JWT` token under that setting.
